title: Planted Transformer mechanism-edge and minimal-cut camera calibration
question: Can opaque interventions recover planted functional edges, complete minimal causal cuts and identity-specific rescue across serial, redundant, gated, compositional and gauge-rotated Transformer-shaped mechanisms?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Opaque edge damage, typed role probes, complete minimal-cut families and correct-versus-wrong donor rescue.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: The registered camera exactly recovers every planted cut and active edge role, distinguishes output-equivalent twins, preserves gauge equivalence and rejects wrong identities in both splits.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Any mechanism family, held-out task or gauge fails the frozen conjunction.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: The same opaque intervention battery under inactive-edge, output-twin, wrong-donor and gauge controls.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: Endpoint behavior or generic response spectra may fail to identify the planted implementation, and the edge camera may fail under redundancy, conditional activation or gauge rotation.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: All mechanism-truth gates pass in both independently seeded splits.

protocols: complete singleton and pair cut enumeration

data_contract.cluster_unit: One planted mechanism, task permutation, gauge and 64-world panel.

calibration.development: One nonformal task-gauge probe per mechanism before freezing; excluded from formal evidence.

data_contract.split_rule: Discovery and confirmation use disjoint task seeds and gauge seeds; all formal thresholds are frozen before either split runs.
leakage_audit: mechanism truth absent from public rows
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Targets are computed by an independent symbolic task parser, never copied from model predictions.

metrics.estimator: Exact set equality and F1 for complete minimal singleton/pair cuts.
Address, payload and rule perturbation selectivity after response-based witness discovery.
Correct rescue versus maximum of three shared wrong-donor rescues.
Output equality paired with recovered edge-cut inequality; gauge rotation paired with abstract-cut equality.

typed_gates.rule: Every registered mechanism passes every gate in both splits.
Complete planted minimal-cut families are recovered exactly with F1 at least 0.999.
authorizes: minimal-cut interpretation in a free-network contract

typed_gates.rule: Correct recovery is at least 0.95, every wrong recovery at most 0.35, margin at least 0.60 and top-one fraction at least 0.99.
authorizes: identity rescue in a free-network contract

typed_gates.rule: Output-equivalent implementation twins are separated by edge cuts while gauge twins retain the same abstract cuts.

budget.right_censoring_rule: No threshold change, seed replacement, mechanism deletion, cut truncation or donor reselection.

stopping_rules: Any split or mechanism failure blocks external validity.
A pass calibrates only the instrument.
Task, endpoint, planted mechanism and free-network mechanism truth remain separate.

adjudication.failure_claim: Failure means this registered camera does not recover the full planted mechanism library under the frozen intervention ontology.
adjudication.reopen_condition: A future campaign must change and independently calibrate the intervention ontology; failed systems and thresholds remain frozen.

authorizes_on_pass: one fresh free-trained Transformer component-edge external-validity contract
